children: Meta Platforms stock is up more than 2% on the day, adding to its 11% Monday pop, despite a broader market slowdown. (The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite index is down more than 1%.)
Today, the company is set to make further announcements about its new personal AI agent, Muse, and its capabilities during its annual Meta Connect developer conference.
Early enthusiasm for Muse sent Meta shares Monday to their highest close since October. The app to access the AI agent reached No. 1 in Apple's App Store Monday.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
